full_judgment: "If the building in question carries a presumption of being abandoned property it is exempt from any legal process, be it an auction sale by the Government itself or through, Court. The petitioners carried the onus to prove the presence or whereabouts or management of the building in question by the original non-Bengali owner when President's Order No.16 of 1972 was promulgated and this burden of proof having not been discharged by them before the Court of Settlement, no case for releasing the holding in question from the list of abandoned property has been made out."
